name: unlock-face-id
title: Unlock Face ID
description: A Face ID style unlock: brackets and a face draw themselves, a scan line sweeps, then a check reveals the blurred content behind it. Controlled or self-running.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status. Omit it and the component runs the scan itself on click.

props.name: scanDuration
props.description: How long a self-running scan takes, in milliseconds.

props.name: onScan
props.description: Called whenever the trigger is activated.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when a self-running scan succeeds.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label of the scan button.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Message shown when the status is error.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered size of the glyph in pixels.

props.name: children
props.description: Content blurred and inert until the status is success.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
